issues.display_title: Issue #550: Centralize User Authentication and Role Validation Boilerplate Across Action Handlers
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Centralize User Authentication and Role Validation Boilerplate Across Action Handlers

Summary

Centralized user authentication and role checking boilerplate into UserFunctions, refactoring 19 HTTP action handlers across 6 modules and eliminating repetitive validation code:

  1. Centralized Authentication Helpers (src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/UsersFunctions.go):

    • Introduced typed AuthUser struct encapsulating UserID, Username, Fullname, Email, Avatar, Encrypt, LastLogin, and Data.
    • RequireUserRole(c *fiber.Ctx) bool: Verifies role == "user" using safe string extraction, immediately sending a 401 Unauthorized JSON error envelope if invalid.
    • RequireAuthUser(c *fiber.Ctx) (*AuthUser, bool): Validates user role, fetches cached UserDatas(c, encrypt), verifies non-error status, and returns a populated *AuthUser with fallback to userData["user_id"] if context local is absent.
    • RequireUser(c *fiber.Ctx) (map[string]interface{}, bool): Convenience helper returning cached user details map.

  2. Refactored 19 Action Handlers:

    • src/Action/V1/Likes/:
      • LikePost.go: Replaced role check, user cache retrieval, and field extraction with RequireAuthUser(c).
      • LikeComment.go: Replaced role validation with RequireUserRole(c).
    • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/:
      • HashtagPost.go: Replaced role and user cache boilerplate with RequireAuthUser(c).
      • DeleteHashtagPost.go: Replaced role and user cache boilerplate with RequireAuthUser(c).
    • src/Action/V1/CollectionPost/:
      • CreateCollectionPost.go: Streamlined auth check using RequireAuthUser(c).
      • UpdateCollectionPost.go: Streamlined auth check using RequireAuthUser(c).
      • DeleteCollectionPost.go: Streamlined auth check using RequireAuthUser(c).
      • UploadThumbnailCollectionPost.go: Streamlined auth check using RequireAuthUser(c).
    • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/:
      • CreateFolderBookmarks.go: Streamlined auth check using RequireAuthUser(c).
      • UpdateFolderBookmarks.go: Streamlined role check using RequireUserRole(c).
      • DeleteFolderBookmarks.go: Streamlined role check using RequireUserRole(c).
    • src/Action/V1/Comments/:
      • AddComment.go: Streamlined auth check using RequireAuthUser(c).
      • AddReplyComment.go: Streamlined auth check using RequireAuthUser(c).
      • EditComment.go: Streamlined auth check using RequireAuthUser(c).
      • UpdateReplyComment.go: Streamlined auth check using RequireAuthUser(c).
      • DeleteComment.go: Streamlined role check using RequireUserRole(c).
    • src/Action/V2/Users/:
      • UploadAvatar.go: Streamlined auth check using RequireAuthUser(c).
      • UploadCover.go: Streamlined auth check using RequireAuthUser(c).
      • UpdateSocialLinks.go: Streamlined role check using RequireUserRole(c).

  3. Automated Unit Tests (src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/UsersFunctions_test.go):

    • Added TestRequireUserRole verifying 200 for valid role, 401 for invalid role, and 401 for missing role.
    • Added TestRequireAuthUser_Unauthorized verifying 401 rejection for non-user roles.

Files Updated

  • src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/UsersFunctions.go: Added AuthUser, RequireUserRole, RequireAuthUser, RequireUser.
  • src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/UsersFunctions_test.go: Added unit tests for role and auth validation.
  • src/Action/V1/Likes/LikePost.go: Refactored to RequireAuthUser.
  • src/Action/V1/Likes/LikeComment.go: Refactored to RequireUserRole.
  • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/HashtagPost.go: Refactored to RequireAuthUser.
  • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/DeleteHashtagPost.go: Refactored to RequireAuthUser.
  • src/Action/V1/CollectionPost/CreateCollectionPost.go: Refactored to RequireAuthUser.
  • src/Action/V1/CollectionPost/UpdateCollectionPost.go: Refactored to RequireAuthUser.
  • src/Action/V1/CollectionPost/DeleteCollectionPost.go: Refactored to RequireAuthUser.
  • src/Action/V1/CollectionPost/UploadThumbnailCollectionPost.go: Refactored to RequireAuthUser.
  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/CreateFolderBookmarks.go: Refactored to RequireAuthUser.
  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/UpdateFolderBookmarks.go: Refactored to RequireUserRole.
  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/DeleteFolderBookmarks.go: Refactored to RequireUserRole.
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/AddComment.go: Refactored to RequireAuthUser.
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/AddReplyComment.go: Refactored to RequireAuthUser.
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/EditComment.go: Refactored to RequireAuthUser.
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/UpdateReplyComment.go: Refactored to RequireAuthUser.
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/DeleteComment.go: Refactored to RequireUserRole.
  • src/Action/V2/Users/UploadAvatar.go: Refactored to RequireAuthUser.
  • src/Action/V2/Users/UploadCover.go: Refactored to RequireAuthUser.
  • src/Action/V2/Users/UpdateSocialLinks.go: Refactored to RequireUserRole.

Verification

  • Lint / Vet:

    go vet ./...
# PASS (0 warnings / 0 errors)

  • Unit Tests:

    go test -v ./src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/...
# PASS: TestDecodeUserDetail_Base64AndRawJSON
# PASS: TestRequireUserRole
# PASS: TestRequireAuthUser_Unauthorized

Problem

Across the API actions, over 40 handlers repeated 12–15 lines of boilerplate at the entry point of every endpoint to validate user authorization and extract user details:

role, _ := c.Locals("role").(string)
if role != "user" {
    return Functions.ErrorResponse(c, 401, fiber.ErrUnauthorized.Message, "Unauthorized")
}

encrypt, _ := c.Locals("encrypt").(string)
userData := UserFunctions.UserDatas(c, encrypt)
if userData["status"] == "error" {
    return Functions.ErrorResponse(c, 401, fiber.ErrUnauthorized.Message, "Unauthorized")
}

userId, _ := c.Locals("userId").(string)
fullname, _ := userData["fullname"].(string)
lastLogin, _ := userData["last_login"].(string)

This caused:

  1. Massive code duplication across Likes, Comments, Bookmarks, CollectionPost, Hashtag, and Users.
  2. Repetitive manual extraction of userId, encrypt, fullname, username, and lastLogin via unchecked interface casts.
  3. Inconsistent handling if userId is missing from context locals versus user cache.

Scope

  1. Centralize Helper in src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/:

    • Define AuthUser struct containing typed fields (UserID, Username, Fullname, Email, Avatar, Encrypt, LastLogin, Data).
    • Implement RequireUserRole(c *fiber.Ctx) bool: Verifies role == "user", immediately sending 401 response if invalid.
    • Implement RequireAuthUser(c *fiber.Ctx) (*AuthUser, bool): Validates role, fetches cached user data, validates cache status, and populates AuthUser.
    • Implement RequireUser(c *fiber.Ctx) (map[string]interface{}, bool): Convenience helper for handlers needing raw map.

  2. Refactor Initial Wave of Handlers:

    • src/Action/V1/Likes/: LikePost.go, LikeComment.go.
    • src/Action/V1/Hashtag/: HashtagPost.go, DeleteHashtagPost.go.
    • src/Action/V1/CollectionPost/: CreateCollectionPost.go, UpdateCollectionPost.go, DeleteCollectionPost.go, UploadThumbnailCollectionPost.go.
    • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/: CreateFolderBookmarks.go, UpdateFolderBookmarks.go, DeleteFolderBookmarks.go.
    • src/Action/V1/Comments/: AddComment.go, AddReplyComment.go, EditComment.go, UpdateReplyComment.go, DeleteComment.go.
    • src/Action/V2/Users/: UploadAvatar.go, UploadCover.go, UpdateSocialLinks.go.

  3. Automated Unit Testing:

    • Add unit tests in src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/UsersFunctions_test.go verifying valid role (200), invalid role (401), missing role (401), and failed auth user cache retrieval.

Behavior Boundary

  • 100% Backward Compatible:
    • Status code (401 Unauthorized) and error JSON envelope remains identical.
    • Handlers receive identical user IDs, encrypt keys, and cache attributes.

Acceptance Criteria

  • ~200+ lines of duplicate boilerplate eliminated.
  • Unit tests pass with go test ./src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/....
  • All affected action test suites pass cleanly.
  • go vet ./... reports zero issues.

Delivery

Implemented on 2026-10-14.

issues.display_title: Issue #551: Consolidate Profile Image Upload Pipeline (Avatar vs Cover)
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Consolidate Profile Image Upload Pipeline (Avatar vs Cover)

Summary

Consolidated the profile image processing, cloud storage, signing, and response lifecycle across UploadAvatar and UploadCover in src/Action/V2/Users/, eliminating ~120+ lines of duplicate storage logic and introducing automated unit tests:

  1. Shared Storage & Lifecycle Helpers (src/Action/V2/Users/profile_image_helpers.go):

    • saveAndUploadProfileImage: Automates directory creation (UPLOAD_DIR/<encrypt>), saves file to disk (c.SaveFile), and handles MinIO bucket creation and S3 upload.
    • deleteUserStoredImage: Unifies deletion of existing images from MinIO and the local filesystem, handling nil and empty paths safely.
    • generateSignedProfileImageURL: Decodes imgproxy signing key and salt, generating signed public CDN/proxy URLs for S3 assets.
    • sendProfileImageResponse: Standardizes the 200 OK response envelope, supporting both plain JSON and encrypted payloads (ec=true).
    • syncUserProfileImageSideEffects: Invalidate and refresh Redis user cache, triggering optional Panorra maps synchronization in production environments.
    • coverMetadata: Decodes image dimensions and MIME type supporting JPEG, PNG, and WebP formats.

  2. Refactored Action Handlers:

    • src/Action/V2/Users/UploadAvatar.go: Streamlined file upload and deletion workflows using shared storage, signing, and response helpers.
    • src/Action/V2/Users/UploadCover.go: Streamlined cover upload, image signing, and old cover replacement using shared helpers.

  3. Automated Unit Tests (src/Action/V2/Users/profile_image_helpers_test.go):

    • TestDeleteUserStoredImage_NilOrEmpty: Validates nil-safety and clean returns on missing image paths.
    • TestSendProfileImageResponse_Plain: Tests standard 200 OK JSON envelope.
    • TestSendProfileImageResponse_NilImage: Tests that empty image URLs serialize as nil on deletion responses.
    • TestAvatarDeleteRequested: Validates multipart form parser detection of avatar deletion intent.

Files Updated

  • src/Action/V2/Users/profile_image_helpers.go: New shared storage, signing, deletion, and response helpers.
  • src/Action/V2/Users/UploadAvatar.go: Refactored to delegate to shared helpers.
  • src/Action/V2/Users/UploadCover.go: Refactored to delegate to shared helpers.
  • src/Action/V2/Users/profile_image_helpers_test.go: 4 unit test suites covering image helpers and deletion triggers.

Verification

  • Lint / Vet:

    go vet ./...
# PASS (0 warnings / 0 errors)

  • Unit Tests:

    go test -v ./src/Action/V2/Users/...
# PASS: TestValidLocation
# PASS: TestDeleteUserStoredImage_NilOrEmpty
# PASS: TestSendProfileImageResponse_Plain
# PASS: TestSendProfileImageResponse_NilImage
# PASS: TestAvatarDeleteRequested

  • Build:

    go build -v ./cmd/...
# PASS (0 errors)

Problem

In src/Action/V2/Users/, UploadAvatar.go (190 lines) and UploadCover.go (148 lines) duplicated extensive multipart file processing and cloud storage lifecycle logic:

  1. Creating local user upload directories (UPLOAD_DIR/<encrypt>).
  2. Saving uploaded multipart files to the local file system.
  3. Initializing MinIO clients, ensuring bucket creation, and uploading files to S3.
  4. Signing public image URLs with imgproxy secret keys and salt via PostFunctions.
  5. Deleting old user images from both MinIO/S3 and the local file system (duplicated across 3 places).
  6. Dispatching user cache invalidation (Redis.ReplaceUserDetails) and Panorra maps synchronization.
  7. Constructing identical success response envelopes with optional AES response encryption (ec=true).
  8. Missing unit test coverage for profile image upload helpers.

Scope

  1. Extract Shared Profile Image Storage Pipeline (profile_image_helpers.go):

    • coverMetadata: Extract image dimensions and MIME type for covers (JPEG, PNG, WebP).
    • saveAndUploadProfileImage: Manage directory creation, local saving, and MinIO bucket upload.
    • generateSignedProfileImageURL: Centralize imgproxy signing for avatar and cover images.
    • deleteUserStoredImage: Unify safe deletion of previous files from MinIO and local disk.
    • sendProfileImageResponse: Unify response map creation and optional response encryption.
    • syncUserProfileImageSideEffects: Centralize Redis user details cache replacement and live map sync.

  2. Refactor UploadAvatar.go and UploadCover.go:

    • Simplify both handlers by delegating storage, signing, deletion, and response formatting to the unified helpers.

  3. Automated Unit Testing:

    • Add unit tests in src/Action/V2/Users/profile_image_helpers_test.go covering old file deletion nil-safety, plain response formatting, nil image handling on deletion, and multipart delete request detection.

Behavior Boundary

  • 100% Backward Compatible:
    • File size limits, dimension constraints, MIME rules, and error messages remain identical.
    • S3 paths, bucket structures, signed URLs, and response schemas remain identical.

Acceptance Criteria

  • ~120+ lines of duplicate storage and image handling code eliminated.
  • Unit tests pass with go test ./src/Action/V2/Users/....
  • go vet ./... reports zero issues.
  • Server binary compiles cleanly.

Delivery

Implemented on 2026-10-14.
